goal: Fix shlog zero-result guidance so it names the source that must be synced

summary.title: Zero-result guidance names the source to sync
summary.what: find's zero-result nextAction now carries the searched source and emits an explicit 'shlog sync --source <id>'; the cross-source variant states which sources were searched. Bare 'shlog sync' text output adds scope:/next: lines saying only the default source was refreshed.
summary.why: find searches all public sources while bare sync writes only the default Codex source. The old guidance said 'run shlog sync for the same selector' without --source, so following it never repaired a stale pi/claude-code/dsh index; the result header still read 'covered' (stored proof only), turning 'this index is out of date' into 'this never happened'.
summary.user_goal: Fix shlog zero-result guidance so it names the source that must be synced

decisions.point: Where to fix the read/write source asymmetry
decisions.chose: Make the guidance carry the source, and disclose sync's scope in text output
decisions.rationale: Changing sync's default source would alter a documented contract for every user; naming the source closes the loop without changing write semantics.
rejected: Change bare 'shlog sync' to write every source

decisions.chose: List the searched sources and keep a <id> placeholder in the actionable step
decisions.rationale: A bare find has no single source to name, but naming what was actually searched makes the per-source follow-up unambiguous.

decisions.chose: Leave SyncReport and nextAction JSON shapes unchanged; only step strings gained the source
decisions.rationale: Avoids a breaking change for machine consumers while still fixing the guidance.

rejected.alternative: Make find's coverage header live-check freshness
rejected.reason: Out of scope: find is query-only by design, and the stale/missing signal already exists in status.

rejected.alternative: Change the bare sync default to all sources
rejected.reason: Documented behavior (USAGE.md: status/sync/list/stats default to Codex) with a large blast radius; the defect was the guidance loop, not the asymmetry itself.

review_notes: Verified against the published v0.6.2 aarch64 archive, not only the local build.

References prior intent int_4c3cd0d7 (v0.6.0 compact text output): that work made text mode the agent default and kept --json byte-identical; this change follows the same split, adding only step strings to the JSON contract.

Newly observed while reproducing: when the synced root contains a live session (e.g. the current ~/.pi/agent/sessions session), strict sync repeatedly rejects with 'source changed during strict sync'. Retry converges, or --best-effort banks stable files without publishing complete coverage. Recorded in the skill failure cookbook; not fixed here.
strict sync failure invalidates that source's existing coverage before erroring (invalidate_existing_coverage); this made the pi coverage record disappear on a failed attempt during diagnosis.

architectural_claims: The read side (find) and write side (sync) have different default source scope; guidance must not assume they match.
behavioral_changes: zero-result nextAction steps name the searched source and use 'shlog sync --source <id>'
bare 'shlog sync' text output adds scope:/next: lines naming the refreshed source and the others
migration_notes: None. JSON contracts and the CLI command surface are unchanged; only text-mode lines and nextAction step strings changed.
